title: The Philosophy of Hedonism
speaker: BBC Ideas
description: Is the pursuit of pleasure the key to a good life? This animated short explores hedonism — the philosophical idea that pleasure is the highest good — and asks whether it can really guide how we live.

title: The Philosophy of Absurdism: What Is the Point of Life?
speaker: BBC Ideas
description: What do you do when life feels meaningless? This video explores absurdism — the philosophy of Albert Camus — and his argument that we must imagine Sisyphus happy, embracing life despite its lack of meaning.

title: Four Secrets from Sports Psychology You Can Use in Everyday Life
speaker: BBC Ideas
description: Elite athletes use specific psychological techniques to perform under pressure — and researchers say they work for everyone. This video reveals four evidence-based strategies for focus, confidence, and resilience.

title: Five Simple Strategies to Sharpen Your Critical Thinking
speaker: BBC Ideas
description: Why do smart people believe nonsense? This animated explainer breaks down five practical tools for thinking more clearly — from spotting logical fallacies to questioning your own assumptions.

title: Is Social Media Messing with Our Emotions?
speaker: BBC Ideas
description: Social media was supposed to connect us — but is it changing how we feel and express emotion? This video examines how platforms like Twitter and Instagram reshape our emotional lives in ways we barely notice.

title: How Stories Shape Our Minds
speaker: BBC Ideas
description: Stories do more than entertain — they physically change our brains. This animated short explores the neuroscience of storytelling: why narrative is how humans make sense of the world, build empathy, and form identity.

title: The Extraordinary Power of Kindness
speaker: BBC Ideas
description: Being kind doesn't just feel good — it rewires your brain. This video unpacks what neuroscience has discovered about acts of kindness: how they boost health, reduce stress, and create ripple effects through communities.

title: Why We All Experience the World Differently
speaker: BBC Ideas
description: Two people can stand in the same room and have completely different experiences. This video explores how the brain constructs reality — and why our perception of the world is always a personal, filtered version of what's really there.

title: The Hidden Clues That Reveal Who You Are
speaker: BBC Ideas
description: Your music taste, bedroom tidiness, and even how you walk reveal more about your personality than you might think. This video digs into the psychology of personality cues — the unconscious signals we broadcast about who we are.

title: Unpacking the Psychology of Seduction
speaker: BBC Ideas
description: Seduction isn't just about romance — it's a form of social influence with deep psychological roots. This video examines what drives our desire to persuade and attract, and the cognitive mechanisms behind why it works.
